programs.name: Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGP)
programs.feeNote: One-year programme. ISB fees page: programme fee for academic year 2027-28 is Rs 34,48,000 + GST for shared accommodation, single-instalment payment, plus a refundable security deposit of Rs 20,000; covers admission, commitment and tuition fees. Indicative and subject to change. GST not included in feeTotal. Same fee page covers both Hyderabad and Mohali campuses.
programs.intakeNote: ISB FAQ: approximate PGP batch size about 820 across the Hyderabad and Mohali campuses (Class of 2025: 819; Class of 2026 graduating cohort: 808 per ISB press release). Hyderabad-only seats not published.
programs.placementNote: ISB press release (6 Apr 2026): Class of 2026 (808 students, both campuses combined) average CTC Rs 37.29 LPA (+11% y-o-y), 1,117 offers, highest Rs 1.56 Cr p.a., 30 international offers. Median not published. Not stated as audited. Figures are for the whole PGP class, not Hyderabad campus alone.

selectionProcess.name: Online application with essays, one letter of recommendation and GMAT/GRE score
selectionProcess.detail: Test-centre GMAT or GRE only (online/home-based scores not accepted from April 2025 intake); no minimum score; minimum 2 years full-time work experience after a bachelor's degree.

selectionProcess.name: Personal interview (shortlisted candidates)
selectionProcess.detail: No group discussion. Rolling admissions in three rounds.

keyDates.notes: PGP Class of 2028: Round 1 deadline 20 Sep 2026 (decisions end-Dec 2026); Round 2 deadline 6 Dec 2026 (interviews Dec 2026-Feb 2027, decisions mid-Feb 2027); Round 3 (final) deadline 17 Jan 2027 (interviews Feb 2027, decisions mid-Mar 2027). GMAT/GRE taken on candidate's own schedule.

nirf.note: ISB is not listed in NIRF 2025 Management ranks 1-100

sources.supports: duration 1 year; batch size ~820; GMAT/GRE; selection steps; eligibility
